## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe clearly. (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like:
- CLI command and flags syntax
- Target directory layout
- Code generation sample (if applicable)

## Alignment with Core Invariants
- Does this maintain "zero runtime framework dependency"? (Yes/No)
- Does this use mature third-party libraries rather than custom implementations? (Yes/No)
- Does this preserve explicit constructor wiring? (Yes/No)

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or screenshots about the feature request here.
